**Main line:** Qxc8+ Qxc8 Bxe1 Qxh3+ gxh3 (or Kg1)

**Motif:** fork (the queen on c8 simultaneously attacks both the rook and queen)

**Coaching note:**

When your queen is attacked, don't just retreat or trade evenly. Look for checks! Here, Qxc8+ forces Black's queen to recapture, then your bishop captures the undefended knight on e1—winning material overall. Remember: a forcing move (check, capture, threat) often converts a seemingly equal position into a win. Always scan for checks first.
